author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: camera body with viewfinder hump and round lens on a rounded U tripod head, with three legs spreading from its lowest point 8 below the body; distinct from the slim-post tripod variant. The rejected drawing had no hump or tripod head and legs fanning straight from the body.
omissions: The lens is smaller than in the reference (r3) so the body keeps 8+ units around it and leaves room for the head and legs; the legs are shorter than the reference's.
drawing_plan: VRECT_L, mirrored about x=24: body r3 rect x 8..40, y 7..29 with hump; lens r3 (24,17); U mount x 20..28 with r4 bottom to (24,37); legs to (16,44), (24,44), (32,44).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'camera' (rounded body, raised top, circular lens); straight splayed legs as in 'easel' supports.
